### Welcome!

I am a versatile Research Engineer/Scientist with a solid background in electronics, embedded systems, and software/hardware integration. My work focuses on applying AI and biosensing to develop scalable wearable health monitoring systems. I am always exploring innovative ways to translate technological advances into meaningful healthcare impact.
**Research focus**

- Wearable & Digital Biomarkers  
- Computational Spectroscopy & Biomedical Sensing 
- Neurotechnology & Brain–Computer Interfaces  
- Computational Genomics & Bioinformatics
- Clinical Data Science (EHR/omics; robust, reproducible pipelines)
